top_news.title: Whale Rock Sank 22% as AI Selloff Crippled Hedge Fund Returns
top_news.summary: Whale Rock Capital Management’s flagship hedge fund is one of the biggest losers in last month’s AI selloff, with a 21.7% drop in July erasing about half of its gains for the year.

top_news.title: Yen Rally Stalls Even as Bessent Vows Support After Intervention
top_news.summary: The yen’s rally stalled Tuesday even as US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent pledged continued support for Japan following a historic joint intervention.

top_news.title: Apollo Invests $1 Billion in Joint Venture With Starwood REIT
top_news.summary: Apollo Global Management Inc. is investing $1.02 billion in a joint venture with Starwood Real Estate Income Trust, a commercial property vehicle known as SREIT that has struggled to provide liquidity to investors.

top_news.title: Prudential Tops Estimates as Revenue From Asset Manager Soars
top_news.summary: Prudential Financial Inc. reported second-quarter results that beat Wall Street estimates as revenue from its asset manager surged.

top_news.title: Codelco Halts Expansion Work at Top Mine on New Seismic Risk
top_news.summary: Codelco is suspending work on a project designed to extend the life of its biggest copper mine in Chile after identifying a new source of seismic risk a year after a rock burst killed six workers.

top_news.title: S&P 500 Rises to All-Time High on Hormuz Deal Push: Markets Wrap
top_news.summary: Hopes for an agreement to revive the Strait of Hormuz lifted stocks to all-time highs, bonds climbed and oil sank, with Wall Street’s enthusiasm also fueled by a batch of solid corporate earnings.

top_news.title: SpaceX Exceeds Estimates in First Earnings Report | Closing Bell
top_news.summary: Comprehensive cross-platform coverage of the U.S. market close on Bloomberg Television, Bloomberg Radio, and YouTube with Romaine Bostick, Carol Massar and Tim Stenovec. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Situational Awareness Not Target of Predatory Shorts, S3 Says
top_news.summary: The losses that forced hedge fund Situational Awareness to sell stocks at deep discounts appear to be the result of highly concentrated positions in crowded trades, rather than a concerted effort by short-sellers, according to the founder of a company that analyzes short positioning data.

top_news.title: Tanger Sees Boost from World Cup, Back to School Shoppers
top_news.summary: Tanger Inc. boosted its outlook for a second time this year, as stronger domestic travel and early back-to-school shoppers have boosted traffic and sales at the real estate investment trust’s shopping centers.

top_news.title: USD And JPY: Trump, Bessent Intervene to Rescue a Weakening Japanese Yen
